name: What's the difference between water mitigation and water restoration?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between water mitigation and water restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water mitigation focuses on preventing further damage after a water intrusion event. This includes immediate actions like water extraction, structural drying, dehumidification, and applying anti-microbial treatments to halt mold growth. Water restoration, on the other hand, encompasses the entire process of returning a property to its pre-loss condition. This includes all mitigation steps, plus any necessary repairs, reconstruction, and content restoration. Mitigation is the urgent first phase, while restoration is the complete recovery.
acceptedAnswer.description: Water mitigation is stopping further damage, like drying and mold prevention. Water restoration includes mitigation plus all necessary repairs and reconstruction to return to normal.
